strategy.thesis: Solo-GP seed fund whose thesis is to close the gap between Southeast Asia and Silicon Valley by connecting SEA seed-stage founders to US-based LPs, investors and operators; sector-agnostic with interest in fintech, gaming and climate tech.

application.how_to_apply: Reach out to Wing Vasiksiri directly; solo-GP can commit within days or hours.

summary.en: iSeed SEA is a solo-GP seed fund led by Wing Vasiksiri (ex-AngelList, ex-500 Startups), operating from Bangkok and investing across Singapore, Vietnam and Indonesia. With his second vehicle WV Fund II (2023), total AUM reached ~$14M; he writes $100K-$500K checks and connects SEA founders to a US-heavy network of LPs and operators.

strategy.thesis: Founder-led pre-seed fund for consumer-focused startups across Southeast Asia, providing capital plus mentorship and a Consumer Tech Angel Syndicate of D2C, e-commerce, mobility and fintech operators who co-invest.

summary.en: First Move is a founder-led pre-seed fund for consumer-focused startups in Southeast Asia, launched in 2023 by former Fave executives Joel Neoh and Audra Pakalnyte and backed by 500 Global. It writes pre-seed checks of up to US$100,000 and runs a Consumer Tech Angel Syndicate; market talk pegs the fund at US$3M-US$4M though the size was undisclosed.

summary.en: Kenangan Fund is an angel investment vehicle set up around 2020 by Kopi Kenangan co-founders Edward Tirtanata, James Prananto and Cynthia Chaerunnissa to back early-stage Indonesian startups. It writes sector-agnostic tickets of US$10,000-US$150,000 and had made nearly 8 investments within its first year.

summary.en: 1982 Ventures is a Singapore-based seed fund founded in late 2019 by ex-tryb Group principals Herston Powers and Scott Krivokopich (the name reflects their shared birth year). Its debut fund closed oversubscribed at over US$20M, focused on pre-seed/seed fintech and AI across Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore and the Philippines; checks run $250K-$1M. A $50M Fund II was targeted from Q1 2024.

strategy.thesis: Pre-seed and seed fund that leads every round and takes a board seat in B2B enterprise and deep-tech startups, supporting founders through its in-house 'Cocoon Academy'. Will Klippgen: 'With the billions of dollars available in venture capital in the region, only a fraction is targeting seed-stage companies'.

summary.en: Cocoon Capital is a Singapore early-stage VC founded in 2016 by Will Klippgen and Michael Blakey, focused on B2B enterprise and deep-tech startups in Southeast Asia. It started with a US$7M Fund I, raised a US$21M Fund II (2020), and reached a first close of USD 50M for Fund III in 2025; AUM is USD 80M+. It leads every round with USD 500K-1.5M checks and runs Cocoon Academy.

summary.en: Forge Ventures is a Singapore seed fund founded in 2021 by Tiang Lim Foo and Kaspar Hidayat (with Alto Partners). Its debut fund first-closed at $21.9M and closed at around $24M, above its $15-20M target, to back a concentrated portfolio of ~15 seed-stage companies focused on Singapore and Indonesia; its LPs are largely founders/operators from Airbnb, Carousell, Grab, Stripe and Kopi Kenangan.

summary.en: Kaya Founders is a Manila-based early-stage VC founded in 2021 by Paolo Campos (ex-Zalora PH), Lisa Gokongwei-Cheng and Constantin Robertz to back Filipino startups 'from Day 0'. It raised $12M across two stapled funds in 2023 and reached a $25M final close in 2025; its Zero to One pre-seed fund writes $150K-$250K into 20-30 companies, with up to $500K from its One to Ten fund.

summary.en: Foxmont Capital Partners, founded in 2018 by Franco Varona and Jelmer Ikink, is described as the Philippines' first institutional early-growth capital firm, investing in Filipino-founded early-stage tech startups from Makati with a Singapore outpost. Fund II reached $21.3M (first close $12M in 2021) and Fund III first-closed at $30M anchored by the Dutch Good Growth Fund, more than doubling its AUM.

summary.en: Orvel Ventures is a Singapore network-driven pre-seed/seed fund founded in 2022 (backed by Ascend Angels and Farquhar/Vulpes Investment Management), investing in early-stage tech across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand. It has made ~35 investments in sectors spanning health-tech, fintech, edtech, AI and sustainability; fund size and check size are not publicly disclosed.

summary.en: Iterative is a Singapore YC-style accelerator and early-stage fund founded in 2020 by Brian Ma (ex-Divvy Homes) and Hsu Ken Ooi. It started with a US$10M Fund I and closed a $55M Fund II in 2022 to back 100+ Southeast Asian companies with checks up to $500K, running its accelerator twice a year. Portfolio companies (Spenmo, GoZayaan, Propseller, Sendhelper) had raised $163M in follow-on funding, with total portfolio value cited at $1.2B.
